title.en: DeepSeek Harness installs and runs again
title.zh: DeepSeek Harness 恢复正常安装与使用

description.en: The harness moves to its latest preview, which installs cleanly. Entering DeepSeek's standard API address no longer causes errors, and Test Connection now checks the endpoint the harness actually uses.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 升级至最新预览版，安装不再出错；填写 DeepSeek 常用的 API 地址也不会再导致调用失败；「测试连接」改为检测其实际使用的接口。

title.en: OpenClaw keeps working after an upgrade
title.zh: OpenClaw 升级后可继续使用

description.en: When a newer OpenClaw needs to migrate data from an earlier version, the migration now runs automatically instead of failing with a request to run a command in the terminal.
description.zh: 新版 OpenClaw 需要迁移旧版本数据时，将自动完成迁移，不再报错并要求在终端中手动执行命令。

title.en: Agents use the provider they were set up with
title.zh: 智能体按自身配置调用模型服务

description.en: An agent with its own API key no longer picks up the endpoint or model saved earlier for its agent type, which could send its requests to the wrong service.
description.zh: 已单独配置 API Key 的智能体，不再沿用此前为同类智能体保存的接口地址或模型，避免请求被发送至错误的服务。
